status: Draft converted to real alpha with explicit user authorization. Revised full-height column preview checked before packaging; game fit pending.
prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied transparent Retribution Paladin unit-frame artwork. This is a production game HUD texture, not a concept illustration.
Keep the same overall wide canvas, left silver/ivory wing, aged gold trim, top sun crest, detailed material shading, and small sun at the right. No weapons, lion, text, bars, numbers or extra motifs.
Fix the functional negative spaces and their joins. The current right-hand bar opening is too shallow. Keep its UPPER horizontal rim at the same height, but move the LOWER horizontal rim downward by approximately 90 source-image pixels, changing the clear aperture from roughly x=830..1640/y=455..550 to x=825..1640/y=455..645 on the reference's 1860x846 coordinate system. This makes one transparent slot tall enough for stacked health and power bars. Redraw the curved join at the right into a continuous smooth silver/gold endcap around that taller slot; lower the small sun center to about y=550 and retain its round proportions. No doubled edges or broken joins. Keep both horizontal rails thin, straight, parallel and visually continuous from their left connection to the right endcap. Long straight middle sections will stretch horizontally in game.
The portrait opening at the left must accommodate Blizzard's rounded portrait with a squared lower-right corner: preserve the round upper/left arch, but make the lower-right of the clear opening a rounded right-angle extension out to approximately x=790,y=685. Blend the silver/gold outer trim around that corner and directly into the lower horizontal rail, with one continuous sculpted silhouette and no stray interior band.
Preserve the left wing and upper crest positions/proportions as closely as possible. Keep all outer and inner empty space genuinely transparent using RGBA alpha, including both portrait and bar openings. No checkerboard painted into the image, no black matte, no solid fill behind the slots, no rectangular outside frame. Entire irregular silhouette must fit inside canvas with a small transparent margin. Return one standalone transparent artwork asset.

Use case: background-extraction. Remove the gray checkerboard background from this game UI artwork and return a PNG with REAL alpha transparency. Preserve only the gold/silver wing, portrait rim, and right bar frame. Make the portrait hole, the rectangular bar hole, every outside area and all gaps fully transparent. The input's checkerboard is baked RGB pixels; do not keep or redraw any gray, white, black, patterned or colored background. Preserve every edge and the exact silhouette of the ornament, including the lower-right squared portrait corner and continuous bar rails. No other changes. This is an isolated transparent sprite asset for direct use in a game, NOT a mockup demonstrating transparency.
